name: job-application-agent
description: Privacy-first Agent Skill and CLI for evidence-based job discovery, application completion, and outcome tracking. Verified résumé facts only, OS-backed secrets, confirmed submissions.

interface.longDescription:
Job Application Agent is a skills-only Agent Skill package for evidence-based job discovery, application completion, and outcome tracking.

Install the companion npm CLI (`npx job-application-agent@latest install`) for the full runtime (scripts, references, managed updater). Profile facts prefer OS-backed secret storage; ledgers stay owner-only. The skill uses verified résumé facts only, confirms submissions before recording them, and never stores passwords, MFA codes, government IDs, or browser session secrets.

This plugin ships Agent Skill guidance only — no MCP servers, apps, or hooks. Shared with Cursor and Claude packaging from the same plugin folder.
capabilities: Complete applications from verified résumé facts
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Job Application Agent and install the CLI runtime.
Assess this job posting against my verified profile and eligibility rules.
Walk me through applying to an authorized job URL with confirmed submission tracking.
